title: Ahonyade Ho Adesoa
intro: Wogyina ahonyade kɛse ho anansesɛm bi anim, asetra a wɔde sika kɔkɔɔ ne tumi asiesie, nanso awiei koraa no ɛyɛ kɔkɔbɔ asuade ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wiase kɛseyɛ nyinaa. So wubetumi ahu onipa ko a saa onipa yi a n’asɛm no ka wɔ bere mu, a ɛyɛ wiase agyapade a ɛtwam bere tiaa mu ho adanse no mu?
clues: Na mefiri Nkɔmhyɛni kɛseɛ bi nkurɔfoɔ mu, nanso mepaw ahantan ne nhyɛsoɔ kwan.
Allah de ahonyadee bebree maa me, araa ma na m'ademude nsafe no ye adesoa a emu ye duru ma nnipa kuo a woye den.
Me nkurofoo tuu me fo se mma m'ani nnye m'ahonyadee ho, na mekaee me se Allah nnho anigyefoa.
Mede ahantan kaa sɛ m’ahonyadeɛ kɛseɛ no firi m’ankasa me nimdeɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ, na ɛnyɛ nhyira a ɛfiri Allah hɔ.
Wɔbɔɔ me kɔkɔ wɔ porɔwee ho na wɔkaee me sɛ memfa dee Allah de ama me nhwehwɛ Daankwamma, nanso mepowee sɛ mɛtie na metoaa so wɔ m’ahantan mu.
Awiei koraa no, Allah maa asaase no menee me ne me tenabea, na ogyaw me aboafo biara a etia N’ahyedee no.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
